pattern: OR-reduction read logic converted to guarded dynamic index
description: Original used a 4x31xbanks OR-reduction to read register file entries, returning zero when read-disabled, addr==0, or bank mismatched. Naive conversion to a dynamic array index (gpr_out[bank][addr]) drops these implicit guards, causing out-of-bounds reads for addr==0 or invalid bank IDs. Correct conversion requires explicit guard conditions replicating the reduction's implicit zero cases.
before: for (i..banks) for (j..31) rd |= (rden & addr==j & bank==i) ? out[i][j] : 0;
notes: Semantic guard reconstruction, not a syntax fix - agent had to reason about what the original reduction implicitly protected against.
